scope: arbitrary-cardinality, entropy-constrained, and fixed-address quantization relevant to ANN

sources.title: Entropy-Constrained Vector Quantization
sources.venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing

sources.title: Quantization as Histogram Segmentation: Globally Optimal Scalar Quantizer Design in Network Systems

sources.title: Quicker ADC: Unlocking the Hidden Potential of Product Quantization with SIMD
sources.venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
sources.primary_relevance: Irregular product-quantizer granularities and hardware costs of nonstandard lookup widths.

sources.title: Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple
sources.primary_relevance: Implicit codebooks formed as products of small scalar level sets; arbitrary level products are not a novel primitive.

sources.primary_relevance: Fractional-bit scalar/vector/trellis quantizers and mixed-scheme allocation in a different systems domain.
